title: Friday Quick Tip
subtitle: Same drills or new ones
hook: Do your players groan or cheer when they hear the drill name?
intro: You run the same throwing drill every week.
Some kids love it. Some are tired of it.
statement: Repetition builds skill. Novelty builds attention.
q1: Do you repeat the same drills all season —
q3: Which drill do kids now do without instructions?
t1: Both can work. But practice runs smoother
t2: when kids know some drills by heart.
ctaLines: Same core drills. One new twist a week.
ctaPrompt: Share your drill habit below. There are no wrong answers.
caption:
Do your players groan or cheer when they hear the drill name?
You run the same throwing drill every week. Some kids love it. Some are tired of it.
Repetition builds skill. Novelty builds attention.
Repeat drills or keep adding new ones. There is no perfect answer.
Repeat or refresh? Share your habit in the comments.
